create_pesq_metric: create a PesqMetric instance with a given sample rate for speech quality evaluation
update_pesq_metric: update the PesqMetric with predicted and target audio tensors to accumulate PESQ scores
compute_pesq_metric: compute the average PESQ score from accumulated predictions and targets
review_pesq_metric_class: review the PesqMetric class and its update and compute methods for speech quality evaluation
test_pesq_metric: test the PesqMetric class by updating with sample tensors and computing the PESQ score
